headline: GPU rental prices held flat week over week across all six tracked GPUs; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: Every tracked GPU posted a +0% 7-day change, with the B200 index at $8.50, H200 at $5.40 and H100 SXM at $4.32.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers list MI300X.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162% ($10.68 hyperscaler vs $4.07 neocloud), while B200 has the narrowest at +77%.
Marketplaces remain the cheapest source: Vast.ai lists H100 SXM at $2.40 and A100 80GB SXM at $1.15, and RunPod Community Cloud lists B200 at $5.98.
A100 80GB SXM is the weakest value at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite its low $2.70 index.
watch: Whether the flat 7-day pricing breaks first in B200, where the hyperscaler median of $14.12 sits well above the $7.99 neocloud median.
